days.notes: Early sunrise adds a romantic touch. Ensure the car is booked with a confirmed fare to avoid last‑minute price hikes. Pack a small snack box for the journey.

warnings: Unlicensed vendors near Mall Road may sell inflated rope‑way tickets; purchase only at the official counter or via the Uttarakhand Tourism app.
App‑based taxis operate only up to Dehradun; negotiate a fixed fare (≈₹1,500‑₹2,000) for the final 30 km stretch to Mussoorie.
April showers are possible; carry a light rain jacket for rope‑way rides and hill walks.
Auto‑rickshaws in Mussoorie often overcharge; insist on meter or pre‑agreed flat rate (≈₹150‑₹200 per km).

Unlicensed vendors near Mall Road sell "official" rope‑way tickets at inflated rates (up to ₹300 per adult). Mitigation: buy tickets only at the rope‑way office or through the Uttarakhand Tourism mobile app and keep a photo of the standard fare list for reference.
App‑based taxis (Uber/Ola) operate only up to Dehradun; arrange a taxi/car for the final 30 km stretch (₹1500‑2000) and negotiate fare before departure.
Auto‑rickshaws within Mussoorie charge ₹500‑800 for a Mall Road ↔ Gun Hill round‑trip; insist on meter or confirm flat rate (₹150‑200 per km) to avoid overcharging.
Light rain possible in April (low‑moderate likelihood); carry a light rain jacket for the rope‑way ride and hill walks.

Nature‑focused spots like Company Bagh and Cloud’s End satisfy the "nature" preference while keeping the pace moderate for a comfortable couple experience.
